verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents developer building blocks: a CLI, a personal API key 'suitable for automated workflows', `bw serve` exposing a local REST API, and an official MCP server. A user could build background automations from these, but nothing in the pack shows Bitwarden itself letting users set up, schedule, or run autonomous background automations. Automatic TOTP rotation and autofill are adjacent behaviors, not user-configurable automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
